programme.title: Mona Lisa And The Blood Moon
programme.desc: A girl with unusual powers escapes from a mental asylum and tries to make it on her own in New Orleans.

programme.title: RoboCop 2
programme.desc: RoboCop returns to protect the citizens of old Detroit but faces a deadly challenge when a rogue OCP member secretly creates a new, evil RoboCop 2.

programme.title: The Thing
programme.desc: At an Antarctica research site, the discovery of an alien craft leads to a confrontation between graduate student Kate Lloyd and scientist Dr. Sander Halvorson.

programme.title: Dark Water
programme.desc: A mother and daughter, still wounded from a bitter custody dispute, hole up in a run-down apartment building, where they are targeted by the ghost of a former resident.

programme.title: Aquaman
programme.desc: Arthur Curry, the human-born heir to the underwater kingdom of Atlantis, goes on a quest to prevent a war between the worlds of ocean and land.

programme.title: Lone Survivor
programme.desc: Marcus Luttrell and his team set out on a mission to capture or kill notorious Taliban leader Ahmad Shah, in late June 2005. Marcus and his team are left to fight for their lives in one of the most valiant efforts of modern warfare.

programme.title: Sunshine
programme.desc: A team of international astronauts is sent on a dangerous mission to reignite the dying Sun with a nuclear fission bomb in 2057.

programme.title: Lockdown
programme.desc: Avery (Jones) returns to college as a competitive swimmer after getting his life back on track. But his life takes another unexpected turn when he and his two friends (Bonds, Casseus) are wrongly accused of murder and end up in prison.

programme.title: Uncut Gems
programme.desc: With his debts mounting and angry collectors closing in, a fast-talking New York City jeweler risks everything in hope of staying afloat and alive.

programme.title: Pitch Black
programme.desc: A commercial transport ship and its crew are marooned on a planet full of bloodthirsty creatures that only come out to feast at night. But then, they learn that a month-long eclipse is about to occur.

programme.title: Terminal
programme.desc: A film noir taking place in a train terminal at night Add 2 male assassins, female assassin, waitress, teacher, janitor and crime boss Add revenge Who says mystery is a lost art?

programme.title: A.Perfect.Getaway.
programme.desc: Two pairs of lovers on a Hawaiian vacation discover that psychopaths are stalking and murdering tourists on the islands.

programme.title: The Book Of Eli
programme.desc: A post-apocalyptic tale, in which a lone man fights his way across America in order to protect a sacred book that holds the secrets to saving humankind.

programme.title: The Tomorrow Job
programme.desc: A team of thieves use a drug that allows them to trade consciousnesses with their future-selves in order to steal tomorrow's secrets.

programme.title: Patriot Games
programme.desc: When CIA analyst Jack Ryan interferes with an IRA assassination, a renegade faction targets him and his family for revenge

programme.title: I, Frankenstein
programme.desc: Frankenstein's creature finds himself caught in an all-out, centuries-old war between two immortal clans.

programme.title: The Transporter Refueled
programme.desc: In the south of France, former special-ops mercenary Frank Martin enters into a game of chess with a femme-fatale and her three sidekicks who are looking for revenge against a sinister Russian kingpin.

programme.title: Spy Kids 4 All the Time in the World
programme.desc: A retired spy is called back into action, and to bond with her new step-children, she invites them along for the adventure to stop the evil Timekeeper from taking over the world.

programme.title: Red 2
programme.desc: Refusing to let anything spoil their romantic weekend break, a young couple confront a gang of loutish youths with terrifyingly brutal consequences.
A frustrated writer struggles to keep his family alive when a series of global catastrophes threatens to annihilate mankind.

programme.title: Casino Royale
programme.desc: After earning 00 status and a licence to kill, secret agent James Bond sets out on his first mission as 007. Bond must defeat a private banker funding terrorists in a high-stakes game of poker at Casino Royale, Montenegro.

programme.title: Just.Mercy
programme.desc: World-renowned civil rights defense attorney Bryan Stevenson works to free a wrongly condemned death row prisoner.

programme.title: Just.Mercy
programme.desc: World-renowned civil rights defense attorney Bryan Stevenson works to free a wrongly condemned death row prisoner.

programme.title: From.Hell
programme.desc: In Victorian-era London, a troubled clairvoyant police detective investigates the murders of Jack the Ripper.

programme.title: Project Almanac
programme.desc: A group of teens discovers secret plans for a time machine, and construct one. However, things start to get out of control.

programme.title: Black Death
programme.desc: Set during the time of the first outbreak of bubonic plague in England, a young monk is given the task of learning the truth about reports of people being brought back to life in a small village.

programme.title: Salt
programme.desc: A CIA agent goes on the run after a defector accuses her of being a Russian spy.

programme.title: Fame
programme.desc: An updated version of the musical Fame (1980), which centered on the students of the New York Academy of Performing Arts. The name of the school in 1980 was Fiorello Laguardia High School.

programme.desc: A recently widowed man's son calls a radio talk-show in an attempt to find his father a partner.

programme.desc: With personal crises and age weighing in on them, LAPD officers Riggs and Murtaugh must contend with deadly Chinese triads that are trying to free their former leaders out of prison and onto American soil.

Mas uma falha de segurança faz com que os dinossauros escapem com resultados catastróficos. Os cinco sobreviventes terão de lutar com todas as suas forças para sobreviver no meio dos predadores pré-históricos.

programme.title: O Mundo Perdido: Jurassic Park
programme.desc: Quatro anos após o incidente da Ilha de Nublar, o magnata John Hammond, responsável pelo Jurassic Park, descobre que no local onde os dinossauros foram criados, ainda restam algumas espécies vivas. Hammond resolve enviar uma equipa para verificar as condições da ilha e convoca o matemático que tinha condenado o parque, mas Malcolm só aceita quando descobre que a sua namorada já está na ilha, junto com grupo de caçadores que querem capturar os dinossauros e levá-los para um zoológico. Nada sai como o planeado, e os dois grupos perdem os equipamentos de comunicação, tornando a situação mais crítica quando os animais começam a reagir contra a presença humana. O terror espalha-se e ambos os grupos passam a lutar pela sobrevivência.

programme.title: Parque Jurássico III

Alan continua a dedicar a sua vida à investigação dos dinossauros, mas os seus projectos são interrompidos por falta de financiamento. Necessitando de dinheiro para prosseguir, o cientista aceita uma proposta para acompanhar um casal, Paul e Amanda Kirby, num passeio aéreo à Ilha Sorna (o cenário do segundo episódio do "Parque Jurássico"). Mas o que o doutor Grant não imagina é que os Kirby querem mesmo aventurar-se na ilha e precisam dos conhecimentos do paleontólogo para encontrar o filho de 14 anos, que desapareceu depois de uma aterragem forçada de parapente. Na ilha, Grant vai ter a oportunidade de constatar a confirmação de uma das suas teorias: os velociraptores conseguiram desenvolver capacidades de comunicação.
